leadText: The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the twelfth season of , Pokémon: DP Galactic Battles, in and ( ).
plainText:
The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the twelfth season of , Pokémon: DP Galactic Battles, in and ( ).

==Volume releases==
 
Four Pokémon: DP Galactic Battles DVD box sets were released in 2011 by VIZ Media and distributed through , containing the whole season between them. There are four boxed sets each containing two volumes with one disc each. The volumes were sold both individually and as part of the box sets. Optional English closed captioning is included on the DVDs.

===Box Set 1: Episodes 1-15===
 
Pokémon: DP Galactic Battles - Box Set 1 was released on March 15, 2011. It contains two discs with 15 episodes across them combined.

The contained volumes were released for individual sale on the same day as the box set.

 

===Box Set 2: Episodes 16-27===
 
Pokémon: DP Galactic Battles - Box Set 2 was released on May 10, 2011. It contains two discs with 12 episodes across them combined.

The contained volumes were released for individual sale on the same day as the box set.

 

===Box Set 3: Episodes 28-39===
 
Pokémon: DP Galactic Battles - Box Set 3 was released on August 30, 2011. It contains two discs with 12 episodes across them combined.

The contained volumes were released for individual sale on the same day as the box set.

 

===Box Set 4: Episodes 40-52===
 
Pokémon: DP Galactic Battles - Box Set 4 was released on November 22, 2011. It contains two discs with 13 episodes across them combined.

The contained volumes were released for individual sale on the same day as the box set.

 

==The Complete Season==
 
Pokémon: DP Galactic Battles - The Complete Season, referred to as Pokémon The Series: Diamond and Pearl Galactic Battles Complete Season on VIZ Media's website, is a Complete Collection DVD set that was released on August 18, 2020 by VIZ Media and distributed through . This Complete Collection contains seven discs with 52 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is 3000083356. It consists of a single DVD case in a slip cover.

It includes episodes with a 4:3 and episodes with a aspect ratio.
